title: Sprite Beds
description: Adds flat item textures to the beds.
body:
# Minecraft's unOfficial Flat Item Beds
Resource pack that adds flat item textures to all of the beds. It is a part of the [Minecraft unOfficial Proyect](https://modrinth.com/collection/hB55ZXtF).

From Bedrock Edition, but with the textures reworked to match better with the JAPPA style of Minecraft. In this night, we present: The ~~Flat~~ Sprite Bed, adding a flat item texture to every single bed in a effort to Make Minecraft Great Again! (the last part is just a joke, don't take it political.)
